annotation.title_clean: Nuevo programa de 35 millones de dólares para el desarrollo de la inteligencia artificial en nuestro país
annotation.title_en: New USD 35 million program for the development of artificial intelligence in our country
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Agencia I+D+i / Presidencia de la Nación (Argentina)
annotation.summary_en: Argentine government news release on a USD 35 million IDB loan for a knowledge-economy export support programme. It will fund an AI research centre, grants for AI solutions in export value chains, and academic networks, including a regulatory policy agenda on AI. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: IDB approved a USD 35 million, 5-year loan executed by Agencia I+D+i and two ministries
An AI centre will be created, including an AI regulatory policy agenda
Non-reimbursable grants of up to USD 1 million for productive-sector AI projects
Support for research networks and AI chairs in the science system
Training and international positioning of Argentina in AI
